introduction: New Mexico WIC supports pregnancy, infant feeding and children under five. Request a clinic appointment to assess the family and explain food and nutrition services.
description: New Mexico WIC supports pregnancy, infant feeding and children under five. Request a clinic appointment to assess the family and explain food and nutrition services.

sections.who: The state lists New Mexico residence, qualifying pregnancy/postpartum/breastfeeding or child category and household-income rules. Participation in Medicaid, SNAP, TANF or FDPIR may establish the income condition.
sections.get: Services include approved foods, nutrition education, breastfeeding support and referrals. These benefits are tailored to the participant rather than a general cash award.
sections.docs:
• Identity for each applicant.
  • Home-address proof in New Mexico.
  • Income records for the preceding 30 days.
  • Other benefit eligibility evidence where applicable.
  • An existing WIC EBT card if the family previously participated.
sections.apply:
1. Request an appointment

    Use the state WIC appointment route or call 866-867-3124.

  2. Confirm attendance and records

    The state asks each person applying to attend. Ask the clinic about acceptable alternatives if a record is missing.

  3. Complete assessment

    Explain nutrition needs and other benefits, then ask how to use the assigned food package.
sections.after: Bring the WIC card to later appointments and follow the clinic’s education and review instructions. Ask for help before an appointment is missed or a required record cannot be obtained.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using New Mexico WIC eligibility and appointment checklist. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does another benefit automatically finish WIC enrollment?
No. It may establish income eligibility, but WIC still completes its assessment.
What if I lack one requested document?
The state asks applicants to contact the clinic about acceptable alternatives.
Can a mailing PO box prove home residence?
The application page asks for a New Mexico home address rather than a PO box.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
